label: Streetwear
description: Street-fashion statements — layering, hardware and silhouette.

items.name: techwear
items.text: matte-black techwear shell layers, taped seams, cross-chest straps, magnetic buckles and waterproof zips

items.name: puffer-oversized
items.text: a glossy oversized down puffer, high funnel collar, worn like armor over slim layers

items.name: cargo-crop
items.text: wide ripstop cargo pants slung low on the hips, fitted rib-knit crop top, chunky triple-sole sneakers

items.name: varsity-vintage
items.text: a vintage wool varsity jacket, cracked leather sleeves, chenille letter patches, ribbed snap front

items.name: skater-baggy
items.text: baggy skate jeans fraying over worn suede deck shoes, faded tee and a slouched beanie

items.name: grunge-layers
items.text: ripped fishnets under cut-off shorts, a faded band tee, flannel knotted at the waist and steel-toe stomper boots

items.name: track-retro
items.text: a retro nylon track suit, triple side stripes, popper buttons down the leg, zipped to the chin

items.name: workwear-chore
items.text: a duck-canvas chore coat, triple-stitched seams, over double-knee work pants and plain-toe boots

items.name: harajuku-mix
items.text: playful layered Harajuku styling, clashing prints stacked in deliberate harmony, platform shoes and charm-hung bags

items.name: leather-biker
items.text: a scuffed asymmetric-zip leather biker jacket, silver hardware, thrown over a grey hoodie

items.name: y2k-revival
items.text: a Y2K revival fit, low-rise flared jeans, rhinestone baby tee, narrow tinted sunglasses and a shoulder mini-bag

items.name: gorpcore
items.text: gorpcore trail layers, a technical shell over fleece, webbing belt, trail runners and carabiner-hung accessories

items.name: bomber-ma1
items.text: a sage MA-1 nylon bomber, blaze-orange lining flashing at the zip, ribbed hem and cuffs, utility pocket on the sleeve
